title: Supply Pay Chooses AiPrise for KYB and KYC Across Its Cross-Border Supply Chain
summary: Supply Pay, the platform for cross-border supply chain financing and payments, has chosen AiPrise to power its global KYB and KYC.
body_markdown:
[Supply Pay](https://supplypay.io/) , the platform that runs cross-border supply chains from invoice financing to payments, has chosen AiPrise as its verification partner. AiPrise now supports and powers Supply Pay's global KYB and KYC.


## Why Supply Pay Chose AiPrise


A single order can pass through four businesses before anyone gets paid. A grower, a distributor, a buyer and a broker can all sit on one order, often on opposite sides of the US and Mexico border. When Supply Pay finances that order, it is extending trust to every one of them, which means every business in the chain, and the people behind it, has to be verified before money moves.


AiPrise verifies businesses against primary sources across 200+ countries, drawing on 100+ data sources, and identifies and screens the owners behind each entity. For Supply Pay, that means KYB and KYC on one platform and one integration, so a seller in Mexico and a buyer in Texas are checked to the same standard. Our[KYB 101 guide](https://www.aiprise.com/blog/kyb-101) covers why verifying against the registry, rather than the documents alone, matters most when a chain crosses borders.


> "A supply chain has a lot of parties in it, and financing it means trusting all of them. AiPrise verifies the businesses and the people behind them in one place."


> Juan Martín Mas, COO, Supply Pay


Working capital moves only as fast as the checks behind it. Supply Pay is building the platform that gets cash to the businesses that keep supply chains running, and verifying every party on it properly is part of what makes that possible. We are glad to be the partner behind that.


Welcome to AiPrise, Supply Pay.


## About Supply Pay


Supply Pay helps supply chain businesses unlock working capital and run cross-border operations on one platform: buyer and seller financing, multi-currency accounts, and embedded financing through ERP partners, with a focus on trade between the United States and Mexico. Learn more at[supplypay.io](https://supplypay.io/) .


## About AiPrise


AiPrise is the AI-powered global compliance platform: KYB, KYC, AML screening and AI agents in a single API, across 200+ countries.
